title: Wind
summary: Wind is the silent and powerful partner of Shauna and one of the deadliest members of the Blood Spiral. Despite the fact that he is mute, he is still capable of using magic, allowing him to act as a silent assassin. The deadly duo travel on Wind's sole colossal flying Titan, Shakrit.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Little is known of Wind's background and early history, and nobody, not even his Blood Spiral brothers and sisters, know what he hides under his mask. [TCG:OAL-031] He was revealed as a member of the Blood Spiral core group, the Blooded Circle, an elite of master Seekers who command and control the Spirals only under the orders of Rassimov and the Betrayer, himself. [Zhalia's Mission] 

He and Shauna met with Rassimov in the Black Forest, who sent them to attack Dante Vale and his team, taking from them the Amulet of Will and Eathon Lambert's journal on behalf of the Professor whom Rassimov was deceiving. During the altercation, Wind overpowered Dante and knocked him into the wall of a house before the [The Secret of Two Generations] Wind, along with Shauna, later met Rassimov after Dante was tricked into thinking Rassimov had been defeated and sucked into his own trap and into taking the Amulet of Archwarder. Within a hall emblazoned with the mark of the Blood Spiral, the three then discussed the coming fall of the Professor and his Organization to Archwarder and the subsequent rising of the Spiral from the shadows of history. [The Divine Comedy]

Wind, along with Shauna and Shakrit, later burst into Klaus' laboratory in order to retrieve the Amulet of the Nullifier, Void, which the Huntik Foundation was also after. Wind defeated Wilder with ease as the Spiral claimed the coveted Amulet. [The Blood Spiral] In Rotterdam, while Rassimov was branding the mark of the Blood Spiral on Den and Harrison Fears and the rest of the orphans, Wind guarded the orphanage. He later fought Dante and Powerbonded Caliba on the Erasmus Bridge but he and Shauna were incapacitated by Dante's Stopglue spell. [Den vs Harrison] 

Wind and Shauna later attempted to recover the Ring of Phoenix from Phoenix Volcano, however they were delayed by the anti-magic field of the Lodestone. [The Dead Magic Island] After Dante's team destroyed the Lodestone, they launched a surprise attack on Wind and Shauna using their newly restored powers. Wind was taken captive but managed to silently escape before bombarding the team with attacks. After invoking Shakrit, Wind fought and overpowered Dante but was forced to flee with Shauna when Sophie Casterwill dived into the volcano which erupted. [The Phoenix's Ashes] 

During the final battle at the Spiral Mark, Wind fought against Dante while Lok drove the Willblade into the Mark. Wind witnessed Rassimov and Dante's deaths and the destruction of the Red Comet. [The Spiral Mark]

Wind later fought against the combined Casterwill family and Huntik Foundation alliance when the Betrayer revealed himself.  In the confrontation, he defeated Lucas Casterwill and his team. [Lok and the Betrayer] He later made numerous attacks on the alliance's Scramjets, destroying one of them. However, Shakrit was defeated by Momax and Montehue with the Hammer, Mjolnir, sending Wind falling through the air. [Dante's Return]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E45_Wind_Shauna.png|thumb|170px||Wind rescues [[Shauna]]]]
Not much is known about the mysterious Wind. He appears to be a strong leader and warrior with the aspiration to get his assigned task completed. {{source|The Blood Spiral}} He seems to have a controlling attitude as he is able to keep his associate, Shauna, in check, a trait shared with Rassimov. {{source|The Titan in the Temple of Sun}} He appears to be fiercely protective of Shauna and become even more threatening when she is in danger, a trait noticed by [[Dante Vale]]. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}} Nonetheless, Wind is a very serious and mysterious foe, and he will do anything to accomplish his missions. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E24_Wind_Shakrit.png|thumb|Wind and his Titan, [[Shakrit]]|200px]]
Possessing the unbeatable combination of  strength, speed, and sheer power, Wind's abilities make him an exceptionally lethal and dangerous [[Seeker]], on par with [[Rassimov]]. {{Source|S1E24}} He is unable to talk but can use his powers and summon Titans without speaking. This makes Wind a perfect assassin because he can use powerful [[spells]] without any sound. {{source|The Phoenix's Ashes}} He relies on an arsenal of high level [[Blood Spiral]] spells and is an experienced and brutal fighter, being able to overpower [[Dante Vale]] with ease. {{source|The Secret of Two Generations}}

[The Blood Spiral] He seems to have a controlling attitude as he is able to keep his associate, Shauna, in check, a trait shared with Rassimov. |200px]]
